page.title: Pulpermill

files.wrongVersion: This file was saved in version {found} of the project format, and this page reads version {expected}. It cannot be opened.

backend.jobGone: The connection dropped, and the backend no longer has this call (it may have been restarted). Nothing was changed. Press the button again.
backend.jobLost: The connection dropped and did not come back in time. Nothing was changed. Press the button again.

records.whyMatchesSeveral: “{words}” matches more than one entry in the cards
records.whyNoItem: there is no such item to {op}
records.shiftLeftOut: A change to {what} was left out: {why}.
records.shiftPartLeftOut: Part of a change to {what} was left out: {why}.
records.shiftTwice: Two changes were given for {what}, so the second was left out.
records.laterStale: The {n} later chapter(s) were written from the old version. They stay as they are, and their beats are marked stale.

app.languageFailed: The page couldn't load that language, so it stays as it was.
app.saved: Downloaded as {file}. Keep that file: it is your project.
app.older: This project was saved by an older version of Pulpermill. Anything newer than that version is blank.
app.restored: Restored. It is not saved yet, so save it when you can.
app.unreadable: That file could not be read as a project.
app.notProject: That file is not a Pulpermill project.
app.isCard: That file is a card, not a whole project. Use Import card… to bring it in.
app.newer: That project was saved by a newer version of Pulpermill than this page, so it was not opened. Opening it here could lose parts of it.
app.damaged: That project is damaged: its {card} card holds something it should not, so it was not opened.
app.confirmNew: Start a new project? The one you are working on has unsaved changes, and they will be lost.

app.confirmRestore: Restore the earlier work? The project you are working on has unsaved changes, and they will be lost.
app.confirmThrowAway: Throw away the unsaved work from {when}? It cannot be brought back.
app.recoveryFound: Your last session ended with unsaved work: {what}, from {when}.
app.undone: Put back what those fields held before the fill.
app.filled: The model drafted: {fields}. They are marked “Model draft” until you edit them.
app.nothingNew: The model had nothing new to add to this card.
app.dropped: The project changed while the model was working, so its answer was thrown away.
app.confirmReplace: The model’s draft would replace your words in: {fields}. Go ahead? You can undo it afterwards.
app.unmatched: The model named {names}, but nothing in your cards matches, so those links were left empty.
app.noSource: Add a note for this card, or an example chapter, first, and keep its box ticked for this card. The model fills a card from one of them.
app.noInstance: That character isn’t there any more.
app.backendBad: That isn’t an address I can use. Type “mock”, or something like localhost:8000.
app.backendMixed: This page is served over https, so the browser won’t let it call a plain http address. Use an https address, or open the page from your own computer.

app.chapterNoPlan: This chapter has not been planned yet.
app.chapterNoText: This chapter has not been written yet.

app.stopStillBusy: The model is still busy after Stop. Press Stop to ask again.
app.writtenBeat: This beat was written from. To change the chapter, write it again below.
app.staleBeat: May no longer fit: an earlier chapter was written again after this beat was planned.
app.lockedBanner: This card is locked because the story has started. You can read it, but not change it.
app.undoBlocked: Undo would throw away words you changed since the fill, so nothing was put back.
app.undonePartly: Put back what the fill changed, except {fields}, which you edited since.
app.lockCardHelp: Lock this card so nothing in it can be changed or erased by accident. You can unlock it at any time.
app.unlockCardHelp: You locked this card. Unlock it to change it again.
app.writerLockedBanner: You locked this card, so it can't be changed by accident. Unlock it to edit.
app.chapterShifts: Shifts: what changed in this chapter
app.chapterNoShifts: No record of what changed in this chapter.

card.tagLiveHelp: What you write is the starting point. The model updates it as chapters are written, and you can edit it between chapters.
card.tagFixedHelp: The model always gets this exactly as written and never changes it during the story.
card.noteLive: Fields tagged “{tag}” are where things start. The model updates them chapter by chapter, and you can edit them between chapters.
card.noteFixed: Fields tagged “{tag}” go to the model exactly as written, and it never changes them during the story.
card.unsupported: This field type isn't built yet.
card.clean: Nothing wrong found on this page.
card.tagDraftHelp: The model wrote this. It stays marked until you edit it.
card.modelOne: The model flagged 1 thing worth a look.
card.modelMany: The model flagged {n} things worth a look.
card.modelUnanswered: {n} of its checks got no answer, so they were not counted as passed.
card.fillTitle: Fill this card with the model
card.fillHelp: Write a few rough notes, or paste a chapter you like. The model drafts the fields and you edit them. It fills empty fields, asks before replacing anything you wrote, and you can undo it.
card.notePlaceholder: Rough is fine: a few lines, or a pasted description.
card.useExample: Use the example chapter on this card
card.useNotePerson: Use this note for this character
card.examplePlaceholder: A chapter you wrote or like. The model learns the voice and the world from it.
card.fillSize: {pct}% of the limit used. The limit is about {words} English words or {chars} Chinese characters.
card.fillSizeOver: {pct}% over the limit. Shorten this text to use the model.
card.fillSends: Pressing the button sends this card, the cards it reads, and your notes and example chapter to {where}.

errors.busy: The model is busy with another job, so nothing was changed. Try again in a moment.
errors.bad_output: The model’s answer didn’t come out in the right shape, so nothing was changed. Press the button again.
errors.too_long: There is too much text to send to the model in one go, so nothing was changed. Shorten the notes or the example chapter.
errors.server: The model’s server had a problem, so nothing was changed.
errors.unreachable: Couldn’t reach the model, so nothing was changed. Check the address and that it is running.
errors.timeout: The model took too long to answer, so nothing was changed.
errors.bad_request: The page sent something the model’s server didn’t understand, so nothing was changed.
errors.unauthorized: The model’s server didn’t accept the access token, so nothing was changed. Check the token beside the address.

card.removeLastOnly: Beats are deleted from the last one backwards. Delete the later ones first.

story.intro: When your cards are ready, start the story. That locks Style, Characters, World, Entanglements and Setup, so they stay as you wrote them while chapters are written. Only the Outline stays editable: each chapter’s plan is made there.
story.checking: The model is checking that the protagonist suits the voice…
story.fixFirst: Fix these first. The story can’t start while a card has problems that stop generation.
story.noProtagonist: Setup needs a protagonist before the model can check the voice.
story.misfitBare: The model thinks the protagonist may not suit the voice you chose. Start the story anyway?
story.started: The story has started. Style, Characters, World, Entanglements and Setup are locked: you can read them, but not change them. The Outline is open.
story.startedKept: The story has started. Style, Characters, World, Entanglements and Setup stay locked for the rest of the story, because chapters are written from them. The Outline is open.
story.confirmUnlock: Unlock Style, Characters, World, Entanglements and Setup so you can edit them? You will need to start the story again.
story.unlocked: The cards are unlocked. Start the story again when you are ready.
story.begun: The story has started. Style, Characters, World, Entanglements and Setup are now locked, and the Outline is open.

plan.title: Plan the next chapter
plan.notStarted: Start the story first (the bar above). The plan is made from the cards as they will be locked.
plan.allDone: Every chapter is written. Use the end-of-story step when you are ready.
plan.castHelp: The protagonist and the two characters at the ends of the spotlight tie are always in. You can add others, up to {max} people in all.
plan.sends: Pressing the button sends the spotlight, the cast, the ties among them, the cards in play and the summaries of earlier chapters to {where}.
plan.planned: Chapter {n} is planned. The beat is below: edit anything you like.
plan.retried: The first try broke a rule, so the model tried again.
plan.stillBlocks: It still has {n} problem(s) that stop generation. They are marked on the beat.
plan.unmatched: The model named {names}, but nothing in your cards matches, so those links were left empty.
plan.dropped: The model gave something that is not a choice here ({fields}), so it was left empty.
plan.undone: Put the plan back as it was.
plan.confirmReplan: Plan this chapter again? The beat you have now will be replaced. You can undo it afterwards.
plan.stale: The cards have changed since this was planned. Plan it again to use the new state, or write the beat on as it is.

reasons.cast_empty: Pick who is in the chapter.
reasons.cast_too_many: A chapter has at most {max} people.
reasons.cast_no_protagonist: The protagonist has to be in the chapter.
reasons.cast_unknown: Someone in the cast is not there any more.
reasons.outline_locked: The Outline card is locked. Unlock it first, since planning writes into it.
reasons.no_tie: Entanglements has no tie to spotlight, or the spotlight tie is gone. Pick one.
reasons.cast_spotlight_pair: Both characters of the spotlight tie have to be in the chapter.

plan.undoBlocked: Undo would throw away what you changed in this plan since, so nothing was put back.
plan.noTies: Entanglements has no ties yet, so there is nothing to spotlight. Add one first.
plan.inSpotlight: In the spotlight tie, always in
plan.pickedIgnored: The planner chose a tie or a pressure that is not in the story, so this chapter keeps the pair it had.
plan.tiesNone: None: nobody in the cast has a tie to anyone else in it, or to a group.

generate.title: Write the chapter
generate.sends: Pressing the button sends the cast, the cards in play (as the shifts so far have left them), the beat and the summaries of earlier chapters to {where}. Nothing is saved unless the whole chapter comes back.

reasons.not_started: Start the story first (the bar above).
reasons.done: Every chapter is written. Use the end-of-story step when you are ready.
reasons.no_beat: Plan the chapter first (the panel above).
reasons.cast_too_many: The beat has too many people in its cast.
reasons.cast_no_protagonist: The protagonist has to be in the beat's cast.
reasons.cast_unknown: Someone in the beat's cast is not there any more.
reasons.beat_blocked: The beat has problems that stop generation. Fix them first:
reasons.changed: The beat was removed while the model was writing, so there was nowhere to put the chapter. Plan it again and press the button again.
reasons.cast_spotlight_pair: Both characters of the spotlight tie have to be in the beat's cast.

generate.stale: This plan was made from older cards. Write the chapter anyway? (Cancel, then plan it again, to use the new state.)
generate.editedMeanwhile: Some fields may have changed while the model was writing, so check the chapter against your cards.
generate.noticed: Left out, and what the page noticed
generate.againConfirm:
Write chapter {n} again?

The cards go back to how they stood going into this chapter. This chapter's text, events and shifts are replaced, and so are the shifts of every later chapter. {later}You can undo it afterwards.
generate.againLater: The {k} later chapter(s) keep their text, and their beats are marked as possibly out of date.
generate.undone: Put chapter {n} back as it was.

reasonsAgain.outline_locked: The Outline card is locked. Unlock it first, since writing a chapter again marks the later beats stale.

generate.undoBlocked: Undo can't put chapter {n} back as it was: the chapters, records or shifts have changed since. Nothing was changed.
generate.undoneGenerate: Took chapter {n} out again and put the story back as it was.

end.title: End of the story
end.help: Finishing the story needs no model. The page folds every shift into the cards and keeps the result as a separate after-story copy of Style, Characters, World and Entanglements. Your own cards stay as they are.
end.confirmAgain: Finish the story again? The after-story copy you have now will be replaced, along with any edits you made to it. You can undo it afterwards.
end.editHelp: The copy is yours to correct. Change anything you like; nothing here goes to a model. Your cards above are not touched, and finishing the story again replaces the copy, edits and all.
end.done: The story is finished. The after-story copy is saved.
end.undone: Put the after-story copy back as it was.
end.problems: The copy has {n} problem(s) that its card would stop generation on. It is a record of the story's end, so they are only noted.
end.stale: A chapter was written again after this copy was made, so it may be out of date. Finish the story again to refresh it, or keep it and edit it by hand. Your own edits are replaced if you finish it again.

reasons.not_done: Every chapter has to be written first.

end.undoBlocked: Undo would throw away edits you made to the after-story copy since, so nothing was put back.

import.safe: Nothing changes until you press the button, and you can undo it afterwards.
import.batchReady: {n} card files are ready to bring in.
import.undone: Put things back as they were before the card came in.

reasons.unknown_card: That card file is for a card this page does not have.

reasons.newer: That card was saved by a newer version of Pulpermill than this page, so it was not brought in.
reasons.damaged: That card file is damaged, so it was not brought in.

reasons.project: That file is a whole project, not a card. Use Open… to open it.
reasons.locked: {card} is locked, so nothing can be brought into it.
reasons.no_target: That character is not there any more.

export.title: Export
export.storyHelp: Every written chapter in one markdown file ({n} of {total} written).
export.storyHelpNoTotal: Every written chapter in one markdown file ({n} written).
export.storyNone: Nothing to export yet: no chapter is written.
export.cardsHelp: Style, each character and the world, each as its own JSON file, so they can be used in another story. The other cards belong to this story only.
export.projectHelp: Use Save at the top. The project file holds everything, and opening it brings the story back as it was.

welcome.title: Welcome to Pulpermill
welcome.intro: Pulpermill turns a few cards that describe your story into chapters. First you design the cards, then it writes.
welcome.sample: You are on the sample model, which writes placeholder text. Type your own model’s address at the top and press Check to get real writing.

design.title: Design your story
design.detail: Describe your story on five cards. For each one, give the model your notes or an example chapter and let it draft the fields, then edit the values until they are right.
design.hinge: When the cards are right, start the story. That locks them and moves you on to Write. You can unlock them until the first chapter is written.

write.title: Write your story
write.allText: the model plans and writes every chapter in one run. It takes a long time. You can stop at any point and keep what is written, then revise a plan and run it again to carry on.
write.eachText: plan the chapter, revise the plan, then write it.
write.fixed: Chapters can’t be edited by hand. To change one, change its plan and write it again.
write.finished: Every chapter is written. Export your story, or finish it to get an after-story copy of your cards.

cards.style: How it is written: voice, tense and tone.
cards.world: Where it happens, and its rules.
cards.entanglements: How people are tied to each other and to what they hold.
cards.setup: Who it follows, what disrupts them, and how many chapters.

welcome.save: Save at the top downloads your project as a file. Keep it: this page only keeps a short-term safety copy in this browser.

patch.unknownCard: “{card}” is not a card that can be shifted ({cards}).
patch.notObject: A patch must be an object of field keys.
patch.notList: {key} must be a list of operations.
patch.opNotObject: {where}must be an object with an op and an id.
patch.opUnknown: {where}op must be one of: add, replace, remove.
patch.missingId: {where}{op} needs the id of the item.
patch.needsValues: {where}{op} needs values, an object of the item's fields.
patch.emptyValues: {where}replace holds no values, so it changes nothing.
patch.unknownItemField: {where}{name} is not a field of an item in {key}.
patch.identityField: {where}{name} says which item this is and cannot be changed.

runall.help: Plans and writes each remaining chapter in turn, the same way the two buttons do, and asks nothing in between. It stops at the first problem and keeps every chapter already written. Each step is sent to {where}.
runall.done: Done: {k} chapter(s) written and saved, up to chapter {to}.
runall.editedMeanwhile: Some fields may have changed while the model was writing, so check the chapters against your cards.
runall.failedPlan: Stopped at chapter {n}, while planning it: {why}
runall.failedWrite: Stopped at chapter {n}, while writing it: {why}
runall.kept: Every chapter written before it is kept.
